data.description:
Discovered from: WL-0MV02VA29009WBEN (producer-rejection fix).

The default-view refresh path opens a FRESH WorklogDatabase connection per withInProcessDb call — twice per refresh (fetchActionableCount + fetchChildrenForItems). Each open is a synchronous better-sqlite3 operation (~46-70 ms on the 100 MB worklog.db, including initializeSchema/initializeFts DDL) that blocks the TUI event loop. After the WL-0MV02VA29009WBEN loop fix (counter-only watch), refreshes are occasional so this is a transient hiccup, not continuous lag; but it violates the strict reading of the <=100 ms p95 input-lag budget when a refresh coincides with typing.

Proposal: open ONE connection per refresh, share it between the actionable-count and children reads, close in a finally; or move the in-process read off the critical render path. Keep the no-stale-cache invariant (never serve from the store's in-memory query cache across a refresh boundary) by still closing per refresh.

# mode-switch-worker: identify the caller in `POST /admin/set-mode` for restart attribution

## Goal

Extend the ContextHub herdr mode-switch worker so every `POST /admin/set-mode`
it makes self-identifies, enabling the llama-proxy to attribute mode-switch
restarts (llm repo work item **LP-0MVAPNC2900145RH**).

## Context

The proxy's `/admin/set-mode` endpoint will accept optional `actor`, `source`,
and `reason` fields (llm **LP-0MVAPNC2900145RH**). The worker currently POSTs
`{"mode": "fast"|"cheap"}` only (`packages/herdr/src/mode-switch-worker.ts`,
`setAdminMode`), so proxy restarts triggered by the worker are indistinguishable
from manual web-UI/API switches in the proxy logs.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `setAdminMode` sends `source: "worker"`, an `actor` identifying the
      trigger (e.g. `mode-switch-worker:idle-cheap` /
      `mode-switch-worker:agent-route-fast`), and a short human-readable
      `reason` in the POST body, without changing existing failure semantics
      (409/network/timeout remain non-throwing no-op outcomes).
- [ ] Unit tests in `packages/herdr/src/mode-switch-worker.test.ts` assert the
      new fields are present in the recorded POST body for both fast and cheap
      switches.
- [ ] `docs/design/mode-switch-worker.md` documents the attribution fields.
- [ ] Build and full test suite pass with the new changes.
- [ ] All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including
      code comments and any relevant docs site entries.

## Constraints

- Additive payload only — the proxy tolerates unknown/absent fields, so the
  worker remains compatible with older proxy versions.
- Do not alter switch timing, gating, or failure handling.

## Related work

- llm **LP-0MVAPNC2900145RH** — Log the requesting actor and reason for every
  proxy mode-switch / `--restart` so restarts are always attributable
  (consumer of these fields).

- **WL-0MSN3FWV5008KQE9** – Herdr plugin: activity-gated proxy mode switching (cheap on operator idle, fast on operator command) (completed)
